operations.note: The instruction replaces the whole reference (чл. 80, ал. 1, буква plus the quoted letter г and its closing quote mark) with q2, but the Gazette's nested quotation marks cut segment q1 short before the letter г, so replacing q1 with q2 would leave the letter г and its closing quote mark in the text. No quoted segment covers the full old words; the old string must be the reference including the letter г and its quote marks.
